title: 第2268章 来自社会的毒打第2267章 这仙风道骨还是很有震惊度的
lines: 几人组都被凌空飞渡的路天行的话逗得想爆笑，下一刻，齐宣还是乐颠颠道，“路天行？虽然感觉你想收我们为徒是好意，但我就是看你这份态度很不爽。”
“想当哥们师傅？接我一掌再说。”
言出，一股庄严佛光就在齐宣身上乍现，而后地球外部都似乎多出了一个浩大如行星般的如来影像，就像是降魔篇里大日如来虚影再次镇压孙悟空那一掌……
堪比行星般浩大的虚影如来，一手展开，掌影就犹如浩大天幕坠落而下，还没真的降临，飞在低空的路天行就像是被山岳砸中似的，普通一下跌落地表，整个人都镶嵌在了泥土里。
齐宣是左右一挑眉毛，几人组瞬间消失。
他们在降魔篇世界忙着各种刷任务提升实力时，也在偷偷间帮了玄奘一把，把这一招给学会了。
当然，刚才那一股镇压天下的气势，只是针对路天行一人，除了路天行，那目前地球上只要是实力没超过齐宣的人，就不会察觉到这一招的存在。
他们是不知道路天行的跟脚，但隐身起来想搞明白还不清楚么？
几人消失片刻后，之前一片仙风道骨、御空飞行的路天行才懵逼且茫然的从泥土里挣扎出来，一脸黑线的看向左右，但不管怎么看，都没发现任何异常，再也找不到几人组的身影了。
“怎么可能？！本帝转世重修，区区两年就把原本的普通人身躯，修炼至金丹境巅峰，怎么可能！！”
没错，路天行就是苏恒刚来这个世界时，就发现过的那个仙帝转世重修仙路的主角。
两年多前，另一波主角于伟凡等人，才刚刚起步时，路天行就已经是筑基期了，两年多过去才金丹巅峰？
没毛病，修炼之路讲究财侣法地，越是初期提升越快，越是中后期提升越慢，难度越大。
就像是苏恒行走的体系，初期成神之前，元始、星河境大能多得是，放在起源星的核心之地，那几乎就是元始、星河境大能遍地走，可神明……必须融合星辰珠，炼化一万度以上的纯粹创世之力，才能证得不朽踏入神明门槛。
路天行修炼的仙道，若没有在合道境之后，接触到仙界仙气，引动仙气入体给你重塑肉身，那合道巅峰与最基础的天仙，依旧是两个物种。
有着仙帝的整个文明传承记忆，路天行转世到地球，夺舍了一个死去的青年肉身，借体重生后，走炼气期的道路真的不难，这是最基础的修炼入门。
以这个地球现代位面，十度左右的灵力环境，也能支持路天行在练气境快速崛起，只要搞一个最基础的聚灵阵，他就能在大都市里聚灵。
改善下修炼环境后快速崛起。
但等他成了筑基期，基础的聚灵阵，对他帮助已经不大，甚至没多少意义了，等他金丹了？……
你想建造更高档的聚灵阵时，所需要的阵基材料等等，就太稀少罕见了，没了高档聚灵阵，又没有其他各种宝物之助，只能靠着稀薄的灵气环境和功法，缓慢稳定的提升。
话说，路天行能在两年多抵达金丹巅峰，这已经是他仙帝之资的最有力证明了，金丹期也相当于3阶神通境，得寿四百年！
金丹境四百元寿元大限，在整体的地球环境只是十度指数时，两年就金丹巅峰，很恐怖夸张了好不好，就说最初的民国综合位面，九叔所在世界也是十度，但九叔什么水准，一般的普通僵尸什么水准、就算任家镇任老爷化身的僵尸，够金丹巅峰的大佬一巴掌拍的么？
而等九叔所在综合位面，出现什么将臣、木乃伊、龙帝复生等等的时候，其灵气指数早就破百了。
李莫愁齐宣等人可以快速崛起为四阶五阶强者，那是他们一直在各个世界乱窜，搜刮资源宝物，就是一个五阶为最强的降魔篇世界，创世指数能是现在的地球可比？？
你帮玄奘完成一个任务心愿，直接就能提取玄奘领悟的大日如来掌法成为你的掌法……
所以说，翩然若仙的路天行路仙帝、突然被人一巴掌拍进泥土里，把他从天空踩进泥土里，不是他资质能力不行，而是到了这个时期，仙帝转世的路大佬，对比开挂程度，都远远逊色于张士良、童健几人组。
路天行这两年多，也不怎么经常现世，两年多前刚崛起于北方某省，意外结交了当地一个大家族老爷子，被对方各种吹捧后，除了初期想要获得一些资源时，随手丢了几颗丹药给那个老家伙，让对方视若仙宝，带着整个家族对路天行伏低做小之外。
大部分时间，这位路仙帝都是在苦修，很少理会外界之事。
这次也是他打算尝试突破元婴期之前，有感于自己底子打的还不够扎实，想出来看看，能不能寻一些天材地宝，给自己在加几分助力。
哪会想到刚抵达南阳一带，就遇到了这么劲爆的刺激？
随手就被人被一巴掌拍进泥土里了？
“来之前，我倒是听刘长义说过一句，最近的日子越发不稳当了，经常会有一些很奇怪的人和事冒出来，原本我也没放在心上，可像现在看来……”
“这个世界的异常远超我最初所想。”
路仙帝也知道，把他打进泥土里的家伙，其实出手并没有恶意，否则他之前要么重伤要么一巴掌给干掉了。
不会是现在这丢了点面子的小事。
刘长义，就是他在北方某省收服的小弟家族的老爷子，对方算是大华北国地头蛇之一，消息很灵通。
对方向他汇报过，世界远没有表面上所看到的那么平静，民间其实有部分很独特神异的人或事，两年多前这类人或事，还算极为罕见，连最高层都没发现过特例，可最近随着时间流逝，那类人越来越多，越来越频繁。
堂堂路仙帝，会在意这样的汇报么？要知道转世之前他可是一方仙帝，寿元不朽也几乎不灭，会把个别小异常放在心上？
现在，路天行突然想起了这两年偶尔间听到的一句很频繁的话，来自社会的毒打？？
content_en:
The group of people were all so amused by the words of Lu Tianxing who was flying in the air that they wanted to burst into laughter. The next moment, Qi Xuan still said happily, "Lu Tianxing? Although I feel that you have good intentions in wanting to accept us as your disciples, I just feel very unhappy with your attitude."
"Want to be a buddy's master? Just give me a slap."
After speaking, a solemn Buddha's light suddenly appeared on Qi Xuan, and then there seemed to be a huge planet-like image of Tathagata outside the earth, just like the shadow of the Great Sun Tathagata that once again suppressed Sun Wukong in the chapter on Conquering Demons...
The phantom Tathagata, which was as huge as a planet, spread out his hand, and the palm shadow fell down like a huge sky curtain. Before it really came, Lu Tianxing, who was flying in the low altitude, seemed to be hit by a mountain. When he fell to the ground, his whole body was embedded in the soil.
Qi Xuan raised his eyebrows, and the group disappeared instantly.
When they were busy completing various tasks to improve their strength in the world of Conquering Demons, they also secretly helped Xuanzang and learned this trick.
Of course, the aura of suppressing the world just now was only aimed at Lu Tianxing. Except for Lu Tianxing, no one on earth who is not stronger than Qi Xuan will notice the existence of this move.
They don't know Lu Tianxing's whereabouts, but they try to figure it out while hiding. Isn't it clear?
After the few people disappeared for a moment, Lu Tianxing, who had previously been a fairy and flying in the air, struggled out of the mud in a daze and confusion. He looked left and right with a black line on his face, but no matter how he looked, nothing unusual was found, and the group of people could no longer be found.
"How is it possible?! This emperor reincarnated and cultivated again. He cultivated his original ordinary body to the peak of the Golden Core Realm in just two years. How is it possible!!"
That's right, Lu Tianxing is the protagonist who Su Heng discovered when he first came to this world, the reincarnation of the Immortal Emperor and rebuilding his path to immortality.
More than two years ago, when another wave of protagonists, Yu Weifan and others, were just starting out, Lu Tianxing was already in the foundation building stage. It took more than two years for the golden elixir to reach its peak?
There's nothing wrong with it. The path of cultivation pays attention to the Dharma and Ground of the Wealth Couple. The earlier the initial stage, the faster the improvement will be. The later stages, the slower the improvement will be and the greater the difficulty will be.
Just like the system that Su Heng walked in, before he became a god in the early stage, there were so many great powers in the Yuanshi and Galaxy realms. If they were placed at the core of the Origin Star, they would be almost everywhere. But gods... must fuse the Star Beads and refine more than 10,000 degrees of pure creation power in order to achieve immortality and step into the threshold of gods.
Lu Tianxing practiced the Immortal Way. If he had not come into contact with the Immortal Qi of the Immortal World after the Hedao Realm, and induced the Immortal Qi into the body to reshape your body, then the peak of Hedao and the most basic Celestial Immortal would still be two different species.
With the memory of the entire civilization passed down by the Immortal Emperor, Lu Tianxing reincarnated into the earth and took away the body of a dead young man. After borrowing the body to regenerate, it is really not difficult to follow the path of the Qi refining period. This is the most basic introduction to cultivation.
In this modern plane of the earth, the spiritual environment of about ten degrees can also support Lu Tianxing's rapid rise in the Qi training realm. As long as he builds the most basic spirit gathering array, he can gather spirits in a metropolis.
After improving the training environment, he quickly rose to prominence.
But when he reaches the foundation building stage, the basic spirit gathering array will not be of much help to him, and it will not even have much meaning. Wait for him to get the golden elixir? …
When you want to build a higher-end spirit-gathering array, the array base materials required are too rare. Without the high-end spirit-gathering array, and without the help of various other treasures, you can only rely on the thin aura environment and techniques to slowly and steadily improve.
In other words, Lu Tianxing was able to reach the peak of the Golden Core in more than two years, which is the most powerful proof of his qualifications as an Immortal Emperor. The Golden Core stage is also equivalent to the third level of magical power, and he has a lifespan of four hundred years!
The golden elixir realm has a lifespan limit of four hundred yuan. When the overall earth environment is only a ten-degree index, the golden elixir peaks in two years. It is a terrifying exaggeration. Let’s say that the original comprehensive plane of the Republic of China. The world where Uncle Jiu lives is also ten degrees. But what is Uncle Ninth’s level? What is the level of ordinary zombies? Even the zombie incarnated by Master Ren of Renjia Town, can it be slapped by a boss at the peak of the golden elixir?
And by the time some generals, mummies, resurrection of the Dragon Emperor, etc. appear in the comprehensive plane where Uncle Jiu is, his aura index will have already exceeded 100.
Li Mochou, Qi Xuan and others can quickly rise to the level of fourth-level and fifth-level powerhouses. That is because they have been running around in various worlds, searching for resources and treasures. It is a world in the Demon Conquering Chapter where the fifth level is the strongest. Can the Creation Index be comparable to the current earth? ?
If you help Xuanzang complete a mission wish, you can directly extract the Palm Technique of the Great Sun Tathagata that Xuanzang understood and make it your palm technique...
Therefore, the graceful Immortal Emperor Lu Tianxing was suddenly slapped into the dirt and stepped from the sky into the dirt. It was not because of his lack of qualifications, but because at this period, the reincarnation of the Immortal Emperor, Mr. Lu, was far inferior to Zhang Shiliang and Tong Jian in terms of cheating level.
Lu Tianxing has not been seen very often in the past two years. He just emerged in a northern province more than two years ago. He unexpectedly made friends with an old man from a big local family. After being praised by him in various ways, except when he wanted to obtain some resources in the early stage, he casually threw a few pills to the old guy, making him regard him as a fairy treasure. He led the entire family to treat Lu Tianxing in a low-key manner.
Most of the time, the Lu Immortal Emperor was practicing hard and paid little attention to the outside world.
This time was also before he planned to try to break through the Nascent Soul stage. He felt that his foundation was not solid enough, so he wanted to go out and see if he could find some natural treasures to give him some help.
Who would have thought that as soon as I arrived in Nanyang, I would encounter such exciting excitement?
Was he just slapped into the dirt?
"Before I came here, I heard Liu Changyi say that things have become more and more unstable recently, and some strange people and things often appear. I didn't take it to heart at first, but it seems like now..."
“The world is far more abnormal than I first thought.”
Emperor Lu Xian also knew that the guy who knocked him into the dirt did not have any malicious intentions, otherwise he would have been seriously injured or killed with a slap.
It won't be this little matter of losing face.
Liu Changyi is the father of his younger brother's family that he conquered in a northern province. He is considered one of the local snakes in North China and is very well-informed.
The other party reported to him that the world is far from as peaceful as it seems on the surface. There are actually some very unique and mysterious people or things among the people. More than two years ago, such people or things were extremely rare, and even the highest levels had not found exceptions. But recently, as time goes by, there are more and more such people and more and more frequent.
Will Immortal Emperor Tangtang Lu care about such a report? You must know that before reincarnation, he was an Immortal Emperor, and his longevity was almost immortal. How would he take individual minor anomalies to heart?
Now, Lu Tianxing suddenly remembered a sentence that he had heard very frequently in the past two years, "beating from society?" ?
title_en: Chapter 2268: Severe beating from society Chapter 2267: This immortal spirit is still very shocking
